title: screening_notes
description: Structured notes captured from a candidate screening call. The five factual fields mirror the interview slots (config/interview_flows/screening.yaml); the rest are recruiter-facing enrichment.

candidate_name.description: Candidate's name if stated during the call, otherwise empty.

years_experience.description: Years of professional software engineering experience.

primary_stack.description: Main languages and frameworks the candidate works with.

remote_setup.description: Remote-work comfort and the candidate's time zone / location.

strengths.description: Notable strengths mentioned during the call.

concerns.description: Open questions or potential concerns to flag for the recruiter.

overall_fit.description: Overall fit for the role based only on what was said.
